title: Finch Circle Membership Tenure Relief on Rush Co-Pay Waivers (Marlowe & Finch Alterations)
content:
Long-standing members of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program receive a tenure relief on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations rush co-pay waiver. A tenure relief raises a co-pay waiver: by 10 percent of the amount the co-pay form waives for a membership enrolled 120 or more whole months before today, by 5 percent for one enrolled 60 to 119 whole months before today, and not at all for a shorter membership.

| Whole months from the membership's enrolment date to today | Tenure relief |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 10 percent of the amount the co-pay form waives |
| 60 to 119 | 5 percent of the amount the co-pay form waives |
| fewer than 60 | none |

**Record read.** The enrolment date of the customer's active Finch Circle membership, counted in whole months up to today.

## Thresholds, both sides

| Whole months enrolled | Relief |
|---|---|
| 59 | none |
| 60 | 5 percent |
| 119 | 5 percent |
| 120 | 10 percent |

A month counts only once it is complete: a membership that is 119 months and some days old has 119 whole months.

## Hypothetical illustration

A co-pay waiver of 20.00 USD for a member enrolled 130 whole months before today is raised by 10 percent of 20.00 USD, that is 2.00 USD; for a member enrolled 72 whole months before today it is raised by 1.00 USD; for one enrolled 30 whole months before today it is not raised.
